definitions.explanation: A traditional celebration, often religious in origin, featuring ceremonies, processions, and entertainment.

examples.english: I watched fireworks at the summer festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{祭|まつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A festival is held at the shrine.

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: On festival days, many food stalls appear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭|まつ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{神輿|みこし}→神輿：10605_mikoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|かつ}いだ→担ぐ：03917_katsugu⟧。
examples.english: I carried a portable shrine at the town festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧{祭|まつ}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: This year's beer festival was really exciting.

notes:
Can be written as {祭|まつり} or お{祭|まつ}り (polite form).

FAMOUS JAPANESE FESTIVALS:
- ⟦{祇園祭|ぎおんまつり}→祇園祭：noentry⟧ (Gion Festival - Kyoto)
- ⟦{天神祭|てんじんまつり}→天神祭：noentry⟧ (Tenjin Festival - Osaka)
- ⟦{神田祭|かんだまつり}→神田祭：noentry⟧ (Kanda Festival - Tokyo)
- ⟦ねぶた{祭|まつり}→ねぶた祭：noentry⟧ (Nebuta Festival - Aomori)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祭|まつ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to a festival)
- {祭|まつ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy a festival)
- ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧ (summer festival)
- ⟦{秋祭|あきまつ}り→秋祭り：noentry⟧ (autumn festival)
- ⟦{学園祭|がくえんさい}→学園祭：19688_gakuensai⟧ (school festival)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese festivals (matsuri) have Shinto origins and involve carrying portable shrines (⟦{神輿|みこし}→神輿：10605_mikoshi⟧) through the streets. Festival-goers often wear ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧.
